# LivoraPulse

> LivoraPulse is a free web-based wellness tracker built for Kenya and Africa. It combines six dimensions of wellness — physical activity, nutrition, digital usage, productivity, mood and environmental (eco) habits — into one personalised LifePulse Score.

## What it does

- Physical: step, distance and calorie tracking, plus GPS walk tracking with route replay.
- Nutrition: calorie and water logging with a built-in Kenyan / East African food database (ugali, sukuma wiki, nyama choma, chapati, mandazi, chai and more), with Open Food Facts as a fallback.
- Digital: screen-time and app-usage tracking.
- Productivity: focus and study session timers.
- Mood: mood and stress logging over time.
- Environment: eco actions, transport choices and carbon impact.
- Cycle tracking with smart cycle-length averaging.
- An AI wellness coach that answers questions using the user's own data.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://livorapulse.netlify.app/): overview of features and how the LifePulse Score works.
- [Sign in / create account](https://livorapulse.netlify.app/login): free sign-up with email or Google.

## Notes

- Everything after sign-in is private user data and is not publicly accessible.
- Audience: individuals in Kenya and across Africa looking to track and improve their overall wellbeing.
